topic: Unlocking Discrete Convolutions: From Image Blurring to Feature Extraction
target_audience: Undergraduate students in Computer Science or Engineering

sections.title: Introduction: The Concept of a Moving Window (1 min)
lecture_lines: Discrete convolution is a sliding window operation.
We use an input signal and a kernel.
The kernel acts like a scanning lens.
animations: Display a gray 1D grid representing a signal. Color: #808080.
Slide a highlighted 'window' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg] across the signal grid. Color: #FFFF00.
Show individual values being captured inside the window. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: The Mechanics: Weighted Summation (1.5 mins)
lecture_lines: Overlay the kernel onto the input grid.
Sum the results to get a single output.
animations: Draw a 3x3 kernel matrix on top. Color: #00FFFF.
Highlight each overlapping element pair. Color: #FF00FF.
Show multiplication of each pair. Color: #FFFF00.
Sum the results into one output pixel. Color: #FF4500. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Prerequisite Visual Intuition: Kernels as Filters (1 min)
lecture_lines: A kernel is just a matrix of numbers.
Blur filters average out the nearby pixel values.
Edge detection filters highlight sudden pixel changes.
animations: Display an image grid using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/photograph.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show a blurry filter kernel using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg]. Color: #00BFFF.
Show clear image becoming blurred post-kernel. Color: #FFA500.

sections.title: Real-World Applications: AI & Beyond (1.5 mins)
lecture_lines: CNNs use multiple layers of learned convolutions.
Early layers detect simple lines and shapes.
Deeper layers combine features to recognize objects.
animations: Display a neural network layer structure using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show kernel sliding over an image using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg]. Color: #7FFF00.
Show extracted feature maps highlighting features from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg]. Color: #FF1493.
